== English Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck comparison ==
The 2022 Appendix A replaces the original lore restriction on the 0 side with a defined-species requirement. Decipher had already allowed species defined in its glossary or supplement in January 2002. The later complete front and D-E1 face express that coverage directly. The 7 side and all other clauses agree.
